pages.text: The Big Bang should have made matter and antimatter in equal amounts, and they should have annihilated into light. For every billion antibaryons there was one extra baryon, and everything we are is made of that one.

Sakharov's three conditions - baryon number violation, C and CP violation, and departure from equilibrium - can all be met in the Foundry. The $(item)Baryogenesis Seed$() is the result: every universe you seed from now on needs one, or it would be made of light alone.
Out of equilibrium, violating baryon number, C and CP: the three conditions for a universe to end up made of something.$(br2)Made in $(item)Mirror Matter Foundry$().
